licence_file: License.txt inside the pack; the line above is its licence text

also_checked.why_not: same author and licence, but the castle kit holds walls, towers, gates and siege engines only, no house walls or roofs

assembly.grid: 1 kit cell = 1 world unit; house footprint x and y in [0, 2], floor at z 0, walls 1 unit high, roof to z 1.63, chimney to z 1.95
assembly.orientation: walls sit on the footprint edges, door on the south face, scaffolding on the east and north faces of the half-built state
pieces_finished: wall-door (south-east panel, carries the door object)
roof-corner x4 (hip roof, apex at the house centre)

render.yaw_used: 135 deg = one yaw 45 deg off the S axis (camera at the building's south-east corner, south and east faces visible); buildings do not rotate
render.material_override: roof pieces use one flat #A33B2E material (style-lock roof red); every other kit material is as authored

scale.why: one scale for the whole building set: 224 px cell at span 4.4269 world units = 50.6 px per kit cell = 50.6 px per tile, the same number the five kinds in content/kam2/buildings use. The kit's eaves add 0.14 unit per side (2.14 units = 108 px), so the house fits a 224 px cell with room for the contact shadow. The first pass drew it at 40 px per cell (0.79 of native) in a 128 px cell; that factor is gone.

pivot.meaning: footprint centre on the ground plane (z 0); the sprite alpha reaches rows 81..201 and columns 36..187 of the 224 px cell, and the baked shadow ends on row 201

atlas.rows_note: row 0 finished, row 1 half_built, row 2 damaged; one facing each, buildings do not rotate
atlas.pack_command: node tools/kam2/pack_atlas.mjs --in <frames> --out content/kam2/house --id house.cottage --kind building --facings 1 --anim finished:1:8:true --anim half_built:1:8:true --anim damaged:1:8:true --footprint 2x2 --pivot 112,168 --cameo <frames>/cameo/frame_00.png --cameo-cell 96x72

cameo.yaw_used: 135 deg = one yaw 45 deg off the S axis, the style-lock cameo yaw

states.damaged: rendered from its own assembled model (lower walls, caved roof, fallen chimney); the sim has no public damage field yet, so nothing selects row 2 at runtime

notes: Kit palette kept except the roof. The kit ships a teal roof; the lock fixes roof red #A33B2E, so the four roof pieces carry one flat material in that colour. Walls, wood and stone keep the kit's own pastel colours, which sit lighter and less saturated than the lock ramps: an open item, not a silent change.
States are atlas rows of one id, not the separate ids the lock names for build stages (house.farm.stage2). One manifest carries the set; the runtime picks row 0, 1 or 2 from build progress.
The contact shadow is the renderer's baked ellipse (35% #1B1F24, 2 px along the sun). A footprint-filling building hides most of it, so it reads as a soft fringe at the base (alpha reaches row 201).
fps 8 and loop true on each state row are placeholders the packer needs; the three states are single stills.

The cameo is the same finished model at the style-lock cameo angles (yaw 45 deg off S, pitch 35, ortho, 96x72, transparent) and packs beside the atlas as a 96x72 cell with the same 1 px gutter. The manifest records it as a cameo object with its own id, atlas, cell and pivot.

One scale for all six kinds: 50.6 px per kit cell = 50.6 px per tile, read back from cell px / world span in the receipt. The cell grew from 128 to 224 px for this reason; the atlas, manifest and README carry the new geometry.
No team-colour mask pass yet: the manifest's mask_atlas stays null.
The kit's roof corner piece is a quarter hip, so the 2x2 roof is a pyramid hip, not the gable the sample renders show.
